rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.004, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-6 LAMBDA sweep up. iter-5 tv_lambda 1e-3->2e-3 jumped hr 0.27630->0.35523 (ssim up): TV was underweighted; stronger TV is strongly productive and not yet over-smoothing. ONE knob: tv_lambda 2e-3->4e-3 (2x), iterations kept 1000, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, gd, fbp. HYPOTHESIS: if hr rises past 0.35523 TV is still underweighted (keep climbing lambda); if hr drops (over-smoothing loses fine breast structure) the optimum is between 2e-3 and 4e-3 and I bisect (~3e-3). Budget: ~950s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
